_comment: Egg exported by Waifly - custom NodeJS Universal runtime, self-built images, public.
name: NodeJS Universal (Waifly)
author: contact@waifly.com
description:
Generic Node.js egg using Waifly's own self-built images (ghcr.io/waiflyhost/nodejs), rebuilt regularly to track the latest minor/patch releases instead of depending on a third-party image maintainer. Public, no authentication needed to pull.

No install script: upload your files yourself (SFTP or the file manager), then set the two startup commands below (e.g. "npm install" then "node .").

Source: https://github.com/WaiflyHost/pterodactyl-eggs

config.startup: {"done":["change this text to something your app prints once it is ready"]}
